Analytical values detected between the Limit of Detection (LOD) and the Limit of Quantitation (LOQ)
are reported with a "J" qualifier. Action Levels are State determined thresholds based on F.S. Rule
64-4.308 and F.S. Rule 5K-4. The Measurement of Uncertainty (MU) error is available from the lab
upon request. The "Decision Rule" for pass/fail does not include the MU. Any calculated totals may
contain rounding errors.
